preflight_v13_diagnostic.role: non-inferential implementation, evidence and safety preflight
preflight_v13_diagnostic.failure_chain: V13 crossed the V12 odometry-gap failure point with a valid belief. During the first rapid corner, the planner/controller used the configured map-frame odometry heading while the canonical belief prediction sent to the manager retained recursively propagated heading. The streams differed by about 0.4 rad. A valid correction at 111.485 s was rejected by the unchanged NIS gate; later correct detector boxes were then refused by the unchanged hull width/height gate because it received the inconsistent heading. The position belief drifted to 0.426 m error, the predicted body clearance became -0.013 m, and the controller safely stopped. This was a cross-node state-definition defect, not permission to relax the detector, hull, NIS, motion-support or clearance gates.
preflight_v13_diagnostic.journal_finding: The manager appended its last ordinary event but could not append session_stopped after the launch service invalidated the ROS context; its shutdown path still consulted the ROS clock before the journal append.

canonical_heading_publication_amendment.rule: When heading_update_mode is camera_xy_only, the planner input, canonical belief-state envelope and compatibility belief pose all use the same source-time map-frame odometry heading and its declared drift covariance. The adapter changes neither x/y nor motion support and does not use camera data or ground truth to estimate yaw.

ros_independent_journal_close_amendment.rule: The detector and manager append session_stopped directly to their durable journals using the last observed simulation-clock high-water mark. The terminal append does not query a ROS clock or publish to DDS after shutdown has started.

verification.command: MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/thesis_stage09_mpl python3 -m pytest -q tests/planning tests/reliability tests/perception tests/experiments/test_launch_config_semantics.py tests/experiments/test_logger_schema.py tests/experiments/test_logger_time_alignment.py tests/experiments/test_alignment_repairs_11.py tests/sim/test_thesis_pipeline_lock.py
verification.ros_build_command: colcon build --base-paths src --packages-select unav_common planning reliability perception --symlink-install
verification.dry_run: 1 preflight run and 30 final runs resolved; no process launched

preflight_release_gate.reference_alignment: own-time bounded interpolation of logged ground truth with max_reference_gap_s=0.15; highest explicit anchor revision per belief state timestamp
required: bootstrap evidence records one admitted camera plus declared start prior
goal reached without collision, timeout, stuck stop or integrity failure
ground-truth final goal distance at most 0.35 m
detector and manager journals end in verified session_stopped
manifest records the exact five-camera roster and unchanged runtime method
terminal stop and producer quiescence verified
preflight_release_gate.failure_policy: Do not launch the final campaign unless every gate passes. Preserve failure and freeze another amendment before retrying.

prohibitions: Do not use any preflight as navigation comparison evidence.
Do not lower detector, image-border, hull, NIS or Stage-08 route-support thresholds.
Do not change the 1.5-s measured-motion support gap.
Do not re-anchor from a single fused event.
Do not use ground truth online.
Do not edit the reused V12 preflight or final V9 campaign configs.
